name: Portfolio turnover rate
definition: How much of the fund's portfolio was bought and sold during the period, as the fund reports it in its financial highlights. A higher rate means the portfolio changed more over the period.

shape.section: Financial Highlights (Class I table for the interval funds)

normalization_assumptions: Use the figure as reported; do not convert it. Show the fund's own annualized / not annualized footnote next to the value.

CCLFX semi-annual figures are marked 'Not annualized' (footnote 5); GBDC quarterly figures are marked annualized (footnote *). These are different bases, so they must be labeled, not compared silently.
Never annualize a not-annualized figure by scaling (for example doubling a six-month rate); that is an estimate, not a sourced value. [Proposed by River; not yet confirmed by the client]
Class I only for the interval funds.

sources.section: Consolidated Financial Highlights Class I (page 127); footnote 5 on page 128
Note 9. Financial Highlights, supplemental data and ratios
sources.footnote_quote: *Annualized for periods less than one year, unless otherwise noted.
